title: PAP Therapy Equipment Fee Schedule: Rental Months, Humidifier Add-On and Billing Codes by Device Class
content:
# PAP Therapy Equipment Fee Schedule

Every PAP Therapy Equipment device class carries a fee-schedule purchase amount, a monthly rental amount for rental months 1 through 3 and another for each rental month from month 4 on, and, where a heated humidifier is furnished as a separately billed add-on, a monthly amount for the humidifier on the same two bands. The fee-schedule purchase amount is the basis of the rental fees and of the repair-versus-replace comparison for the class.

## Billing codes and method of furnishing

| Device class | Device code | Furnished when billed to coverage as | Rental month anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | E0601 | self-pay purchase (never billed to coverage) | not applicable |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | E0601 | capped rental | anniversary of the setup date |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | E0601 | capped rental | anniversary of the setup date |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | E0470 | capped rental | anniversary of the setup date |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | E0471 | capped rental | anniversary of the setup date |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | E0471 | capped rental | anniversary of the setup date |

## Device amounts (USD)

| Device class | Fee-schedule purchase amount | Rental months 1 to 3, per month | Rental month 4 on, per month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 862.40 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 862.40 | 86.24 | 64.68 |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 862.40 | 86.24 | 64.68 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 1893.60 | 189.36 | 142.02 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 4256.40 | 425.64 | 319.23 |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 4256.40 | 425.64 | 319.23 |

## Heated humidifier add-on (USD)

| Device class | Billed as a separate rental add-on | Add-on code | Months 1 to 3, per month | Month 4 on, per month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | no | not billed | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | yes | E0562 | 25.62 | 19.22 |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | yes | E0562 | 25.62 | 19.22 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | yes | E0562 | 25.62 | 19.22 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | yes | E0562 | 25.62 | 19.22 |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | yes | E0562 | 25.62 | 19.22 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The Travel CPAP System (E0601) is furnished only as a self-pay purchase, so its rental and add-on amounts are 0.00 and no rental month anchor applies to it.
- For every rented class the rental month anchor is the anniversary of the setup date: each rental month's first day is fixed by that anniversary.
- The CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) and the Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) share one device code and one set of amounts; the Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) and the Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) likewise share theirs.

**Reading the bands (hypothetical month numbers).** A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) in rental month 3 is on the months 1 to 3 band: 189.36 for the device and, with a billed humidifier, 25.62 for the add-on. The same device in rental month 4 moves to the month 4 on band: 142.02 and 19.22.
